data.title: Congress Pushes Odds of a Government Shutdown to December as Bitcoin Watches
data.description: The House passed a stopgap funding bill 220-205 on July 21, moving its proposed government-funding deadline from September 30 to December 4 and placing it after the midterms. This has led to the odds of a Government shutdown happening across all predition markets.But that is no longer the full picture: ...
